notes.title: [FHUOR: Season 2] Teaser Video Now Live! 🎬💖
notes.content:
Hello from the Five Hearts Under One Roof 2 dev team! 💌

The moment you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
[h3]✨ The official teaser video for Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2 has just been released! ✨[/h3]

This sneak peek gives you a taste of the drama, romance, and surprises that await in the new season of Yuman’s boarding house.
New faces, deeper connections, and unforgettable moments are just around the corner...😆

📺 Want to see it right now?
[h3]👉 Check out the teaser on our Steam page![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731020/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof_season2/ 

We’d love to hear your thoughts—who’s caught your eye already? 👀💖

Your love and excitement mean the world to us, and they inspire us to keep working hard to make Season 2 truly special. 
And yes—we can’t wait to share the demo of Five Hearts Under One Roof 2 with you!

Please hang tight just a little longer—we’ll see you soon in the demo!

Thank you for all your love and support! 💕

📲 For the latest updates, follow us on Instagram:
👉 [url=https://www.instagram.com/beautygirls_story]INSTAGRAM[/url]

notes.title: [FHUOR: Season 2] Demo Coming This September! 🏠💖
notes.content:
Hello from the Five Hearts Under One Roof dev team! 💌

Drum roll~ 🥁 The wait is over!
Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2 DEMO Version is coming this September 🎊
For everyone who’s been eagerly waiting, we’re giving you a special sneak peek into the love-filled boarding house.

[h3]💡 What’s in the DEMO Version?

✅ Play through Chapter 1 of the full game, which will feature 6 main chapters and 6 ending chapters.
✅ Try out some of the new choices and mini-games prepared for the full release.
✅ Get an early look at unforgettable moments with the six heroines of Season 2.[/h3]

Think this little preview can capture all the excitement we’ve prepared? 😉
Step back into Yuman’s boarding house and feel the start of a brand new season, where new faces, even deeper stories, and unexpected feelings are waiting to unfold.
Don’t you want to see where it all leads? 💖

Thank you as always for your patience and love. We can’t wait for you to try it out and share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: [FHUOR: Season 2] They're Coming! Sneak Peek at the Cast!
notes.content:
Hello from the Five Hearts Under One Roof dev team!

[h3]Thank you so much for waiting! 🙇
Thanks to all your love and support, Five Hearts Under One Roof? Season 2 is just around the corner.
To show our appreciation, we’ve prepared a special cast preview video![/h3]

Ready to see some familiar faces?

🎬 Mal-sook & Min-jung – “High school hearts, incoming!”
The queens of teen crush moments are back, and just as charming as ever.
👉[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3iC6F0SR4j0] [Watch the video][/url]

🎬 Manager Dong-geuran – “Why is the manager here...?!”
Somewhere between adorable and all grown up—get ready for peak chaos.
👉 [url=https://youtu.be/iyDvoEL13fM?feature=shared][Watch the video][/url]

And this season, we’re welcoming some brand new faces
brought to you by the Milk Film channel! 🎊

🩺 Bbanggyul – “Nurse energy unlocked.”
Calm and caring, with pro-level bedside vibes. What role will she play this time?
👉 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xF4O8crnUY][Watch the video][/url]

💎 Yunamong – “Warning: Elegant chaebol energy ahead.”
The type to steal your heart before your wallet.
👉[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SVkAM7htQ-s&t=280s] [Watch the video][/url]

🌟 Yu-jeong Yang – “Wait, who is she?!”
A rising star discovered by Milk Film. She just might be this season’s biggest surprise—
small beginnings, big impact. Remember the name!

Already having a hard time choosing a favorite?
Let these preview videos steal your heart first. 💘
Once again, this house is anything but peaceful...

Thanks so much for your love and excitement! 💕

📲 Stay updated on all things Five Hearts S2 via our official Instagram:
